scope: Massless real Gaussian SJ scalar on fixed flat 1+1 causal diamonds; no gravity dynamics or feature-utility claim
prior_exploration: Earlier unfrozen pilot used N=64,128,256,512,1024 with eight seeds each (2026101700+101*N+r). Observed kernel obstructions and cutoff-sensitive finite-size entropies. It is not confirmatory evidence and is excluded here.

sampling.generator: numpy.PCG64 via default_rng; independent fixed-N uniform samples in [-1,1]^2 null coordinates
sampling.statistical_unit: one independently generated whole causal set

regularization.kernel_policy: No finite entropy on an unregularized kernel mismatch; explicit physical projection reported separately

analysis.response: double-cutoff entropy in nats at coefficient=1
analysis.estimator: OLS with intercept over all primary runs; bootstrap whole orders within each N stratum
analysis.pass_rule: All 64 primary-coefficient entropies valid, full primary 95% percentile interval inside 1/3 +/- 0.05, and primary-size point slopes for coefficients 0.75 and 1.25 inside that band
analysis.interpretation: Finite-range numerical reference agreement only; margin is a declared engineering tolerance, not a theorem or a physical significance threshold
secondary: adjacent-size slopes of mean entropy against mean predictor
analysis.missing_policy: No replacement seeds; missing or invalid primary case makes reference INCOMPLETE; other outcomes REFERENCE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
analysis.no_retuning: Do not change cutoff, seeds, fit range or acceptance after target observation

next_gate: Geometry perturbations and equal-budget incremental utility require a separately frozen follow-up; no automatic scientific PASS from software tests
